info.title: Bidora authenticated password change
info.description: Fresh-password authenticated credential replacement with auth-epoch advancement and browser-session rotation.

post.description: Password-backed verified accounts only. Requires exact Origin, session-bound CSRF, matching account email and fresh current-password proof through the fail-closed login limiter. Success changes the password, advances credential version and auth epoch, revokes every prior session, and issues one replacement session atomically.

new_password.description: Valid UTF-8 encoded in 12–128 bytes; no trimming or normalization.

204.description: Password changed; replacement session and CSRF cookies supplied, with no response body.

Failure.description: Generic safe failure without credential, identity, session or dependency details.
